faqs.question: Is this only for one developer?
faqs.answer: No. DevFolio is a reusable multi-user platform where any developer can sign up, build a portfolio, and publish a public page.

faqs.question: Can recruiters evaluate portfolios quickly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Public pages are designed to highlight role, stack, projects, experience, and contact actions in a clear scan-friendly flow.

faqs.question: Can developers update their portfolio after publishing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Developers can save drafts, preview changes, publish, unpublish, and update content at any time.
